title: Safe Pilot
tagline: Steer into an asteroid storm and watch a live safety filter bend your path.

paper.title: Convex Safety Filtering via Spectral Selection for Nonconvex Safe Sets

novelty: no known implementation (not verified); this demo fuses a simplified velocity safety filter with pointer-steered arcade flight.
description: A self-contained browser flight game that makes a guardian filter visible as it redirects steering around drifting asteroids.
howItWorks: The ship's desired velocity is projected through nearby obstacle half-space constraints using iterative projection. This illustrates safety filtering but does not implement the paper's spectral selection method or establish a real-world safety guarantee.
controls: Drag or tap to steer; use WASD or arrow keys. Toggle Guardian ON/OFF to compare filtered and raw flight. When OFF, a collision ends the flight; tap to retry.
